comments: Sam place was at the center, easy to find,  restaurants everywhere, there is a lift and accessible to BUS which is if your going back to airport. I would recommend to stay here again.
房间非常好，床至少有一米八，干净整洁，卫生间也一应俱全，房间有免费wifi ，有大陆的转换插头，门口有自助的纸巾牙膏牙刷垃圾袋可以用，有微波炉可以热饭。楼下不远就是地铁，住起来非常方便。最重要的是房东Ken人非常好，热心的跟我们介绍房间里的东西使用方法，免费帮我们寄存行李，非常满意，下次来还住这里！
location very good. but if you use MTR it's not easy bring the big suitcase because no lift or escalator.  recommend use Taxi. near to the temple street you can walk.
单位位置很好，离地铁站很近（大概就在花园街与弼街交界处，入口于水果档背后）附近一应俱全，要乜有乜，无敌顶呱呱！如果价钱可以再优惠点就10星满分了😆
非常不错。下次来还会继续选择

Very happy with our stay here! The only thing to be mindful of is that there was a recent incident in the building that left the lift under repair. Manageable if you don't have heavy bags, we had 15kg bags and managed fine going up to the second level. We arrived at 2am and check in was flexible and self managed. No issues. Once you're in the room you forget the outside world.
環境舒適
房间很干净 房东也很好

Vincent and his friends ( Leo, who welcomed us on the first day) were very welcoming and friendly. They dealt with our enquiries graciously and recommended places for us to eat and routes we should take to sightsee. Vincent was easily contactable through WhatsApp and responsive.
The accomodation was exactly the same as portrayed in the pictures and very comfortable, a good size compared to usual Hong Kong hotel rooms or apartments which can be a little small. The room was well furnished and there was bottled water provided for us daily.
The impeccable service, good housekeeping and pleasant amenities made up for the slightly inconvenient hotel location ( Austin station is on a less popular and accessible MTR line), and I highly recommend this location to anyone looking for a more personal Hong Kong experience.

I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The host was responsive and accommodating, which made everything smooth. We really appreciated the thoughtful touches like the toiletries and fresh towels. Would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
非常好的旅馆，设计很有格调，房间虽然不大，但床躺两个人还是很足够的。厕所也不小，远超预期
We enjoyed our stay at Lisa's place. She is very responsive and very helpful. Will definitely recommend her place to our friends and families who are planning to go to HK!😊
It’s exactly what you pay for. We enjoyed it ✨

I stayed there for 2 nights of 3 people, the bed was quite small it can fit 2 slim people but not larger one in each bedroom.
There are A/C in every room. You can stay comfortably with any weather conditions.

This was a great place to stay, right next to the night market and close to the main attractions in the area. The host was nice, and it was perfect for the layover I had in Hong Kong. I would definitely consider coming back.
